title: AgentCE deviation register
description: deviations.yaml (SPEC 6.5): accepted or temporary departures from a control, each with a rationale, a compensating control, an owner, an approver, an expiry, and evidence references. A deviation yields the outcome partial, never conformant, and is validated further by deviation_lint (SPEC Appendix F); it is not a way to absorb operational noise (that is tolerance, SPEC 9.2).

control.description: The control this deviation applies to.

owner.description: The accountable party; deviation_lint refuses approver == owner.

expiry.description: deviation_lint refuses an expired or over-long deviation.
